CustomField.label: Max Org Health Live Rows
CustomField.description: Default row ceiling for Org Health's Tier-2 bounded aggregate queries (ADR-0026) — e.g. "top N objects by field count." A section may override this via OI_Org_Health_Section_Config__mdt.Live_Row_Ceiling__c. When the ceiling is hit, the DTO must set truncated=true rather than silently returning a partial result as if it were exhaustive.
